summary: This is a routine earnings announcement filing (Form 6-K) by GDS Holdings Ltd for its first quarter 2026 financial results. The company will report results after the Hong Kong market close and before the U.S. market open on May 20, 2026, followed by an earnings conference call. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing also includes a notice of a board meeting for the earnings release. This is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer with no event-driven special situation.
